newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares end firm but below 1,400.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares end firm but below 1,400.

text.p: Austrian shares end off goal of 1,400 points but buoyant. Traders expect the index to remain below 1,400 ahead of the expiry of July futures and options on Friday. Market seen well-supported at 1,380 to 1,385 points.
*13 losers outweigh seven gainers, one unchanged
*Top gainer luxury hosiery maker Wolford, up 4.07 pct at 1,280 ats
*Top loser regional utility EVN, down 2.28 pct at 1,544 ats
*July ATX future up 5.0 points at 1,402 -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12257
